name: Saskatchewan
title: Saskatchewan Rebate Calculator 2026: SaskEnergy Equipment Rebates
h1: Saskatchewan Rebate Calculator 2026: What You Could Get Back
desc: Free Saskatchewan rebate calculator. SaskEnergy gas furnace, boiler and water heater rebates and SaskPower's free Energy Assistance Program. Closed programs listed. Every number sourced.
intro: Answer a few questions and see which Saskatchewan rebates fit your home, with a source for every number.
short: SaskEnergy pays $325 for a 97% efficient gas furnace, $750 for a boiler, $800 for a combi boiler and $1,000 for a tankless or condensing water heater. SaskPower's Energy Assistance Program gives free upgrades. SaskPower's retrofit rebate ended in April 2026.
faq: How much does SaskEnergy pay for a new furnace?

$325 for a furnace with at least 97.0% AFUE that is on SaskEnergy's list. It must replace a natural gas furnace that is out of warranty, installed by a licensed gas contractor. Apply within 120 days of installation.
Is there a heat pump rebate in Saskatchewan?
We found no SaskPower or SaskEnergy rebate for heat pumps, insulation or windows on October 21, 2026. SaskPower's Home Efficiency Retrofit Rebate ended in April 2026.
What is the Energy Assistance Program?

A free SaskPower program for homeowners, renters and landlords. It installs LED bulbs, aerators, showerheads, pipe wrap, a block heater timer and a smart thermostat if eligible, and says it can save up to $230 a year.
Yes. SaskEnergy says it may change or cancel the program at any time without notice, and the rebate amount is set by the schedule in effect when it receives your complete application.
